unique_value: batch admission is governed by an explicit capacity and latency model rather than accepting work until queues collapse
predicted p95 latency is compared against a workload-class budget before admission
unknown or cold-start workload classes refuse until their declared minimum evidence requirement is met
nonstationary service evidence tightens admission through bounded fast/slow estimates and a clamped safety factor
over-budget work is refused instead of degrading tail latency silently

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository contributes the Groq-specialist implementation; future evidence can refine the role while preserving identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Authenticate observation provenance, expire stale model evidence, persist estimator state safely across restart, and coordinate budgets across controller instances without weakening hard refusal.
nonclaims: service-time observations are caller supplied rather than authenticated provider telemetry
no arbitrary policy learning or unbounded online optimization
no restart-safe or distributed adaptive state yet
